steps: Make the $$y$$ coefficients match: multiply equation 1 by $$-4$$ and equation 2 by $$-6$$.

Replace column 2 with the constants: $$D_{y}=\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&5\end{vmatrix}=10$$, so $$y=\dfrac{D_{y}}{D}=\dfrac{10}{10}=1$$.
Back-substitute from the echelon form to obtain $$x=3, y=1$$.
